description: This file defines a static class DirectoryInstruments that contains metrics instruments (counters, histograms, gauges) related to directory operations within Orleans Runtime. It sets up various metrics for tracking lookups, snapshot transfers, range recovery, ring sizes, and registration actions.

classes.name: DirectoryInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing instrumentation for directory-related metrics in Orleans Runtime.

methods.name: RegisterDirectoryPartitionSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for directory partition size.

methods.name: RegisterCacheSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for cache size.

methods.name: RegisterRingSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for ring size.

methods.name: RegisterMyPortionRingDistanceObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the distance of my portion of the ring.

methods.name: RegisterMyPortionRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the percentage of my portion of the ring.

methods.name: RegisterMyPortionAverageRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the average ring percentage of my portion.
